description:
Technical Skill :- 
 Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required. Will also consider one year of relevant work experience in lieu of every year of education. 

 5+ years of experience in Systems Analysis and Application Development); 3+ years of experience required if candidate possesses a related advanced degree. 
 3+ years of Advanced Java programming/ systems design.
 Skill Set – 

 Highly experienced in Core Java J2EE 

 Proficient in J2EE concepts and Expertise on MVC architecture.
 Sufficient expertise on JSF.
 Sufficient expertise on Web service.
 Have thoroughly worked on XML, XSD, XSL.
 Have in depth knowledge and expertise on Design patterns.
 Should have understanding or expertise on Seam annotations.
 Should have sufficient understanding on HTML, CSS and Javascript technologies.
 Should have sufficient expertise on Relational Databases.
 Understanding/ hands on experience on Linux is a plus.
 

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 12+ Months
